decisions.statement: The filter constants the upstream file reads are seeded before the file runs.
The EU list and the NA list are built by calling upstream's own builders.
An entry is refused where any field that entry has is not the shape expected.
A list longer than a part's ceiling is written as numbered parts and a barrel.
Every generated file already there is removed before the new ones are written.
The package the ported data lands in is read from the library's own naming.
The checkout the ported files land in is named by the caller.
What a run has cleared and written is named to the caller as each of them happens.

definition: the house library upstream PortToFriendsHouse carries, copied out as TypeScript
